queueProposal.summary: The active R34/R33 draw owner bypasses R30TryXyzrhw* and falls directly to the R29 trampoline. Restore bounded XYZRHW pre-dispatch at the final owner with handled-result semantics that cannot double draw.
R30ApplyStereoSkyGlow selects the opposite intermediate texture: one-step must composite reduced after horizontal blur; two-step must composite temp after vertical blur.
R33Dispatch classifies a screen-space pass and R33TryHud immediately classifies it again. Thread the already-computed R30ScreenSpaceKind into R33TryHud.

R15 captures a live D3DSBT_ALL object at fresh-device creation and later applies that same object after ResetEx. State-block objects are device resources and are not a safe post-Reset snapshot contract. Replace this with explicit fresh-device baseline values or recreate/capture an equivalent state block after ResetEx before use; never Apply a pre-Reset state-block object after ResetEx.
